reviews.title: Anuncia Mier que buscan reunión interparlamentaria entre los congresos de México y USA para abordar temas prioritarios de la agenda bilateral
reviews.source_review_method: AI-assisted publisher-page inspection via public web retrieval
reviews.evidence_summary: The publisher article describes a proposed meeting between Mexican and US legislators; the article supplies no event in Réunion, and reunión is used as the Spanish word for meeting.

reviews.title: Ignacio Mier ve viable reunión interparlamentaria con Estados Unidos
reviews.source_review_method: AI-assisted publisher-page inspection via public web retrieval
reviews.evidence_summary: The publisher article is about Ignacio Mier proposing Mexican-US interparliamentary talks on trade, security and migrants; reunión is a Spanish noun for meeting, not a reference to the island of Réunion.

reviews.title: Catorce lagos del sur de Chile podrían contar con nuevas normas ambientales para prevenir su contaminación
reviews.source_review_method: AI-assisted publisher-page inspection via public web retrieval
reviews.evidence_summary: The publisher article describes water quality rules for 14 lakes in Chilean regions La Araucanía, Los Ríos and Los Lagos, naming named lakes and a Chilean Ministry consultation; it does not discuss Lagos, Nigeria.
